title: Cosmos Notebook
tagline: Learn astrophysics and quantum physics by doing — one kitchen-table experiment at a time.
description: A free community lab notebook: follow a library of home physics experiments, track your progress, and share your write-ups.
author: the Cosmos Notebook community

phases.title: Get oriented
phases.summary: A short, beautiful overview of modern physics, one easy indoor experiment, and learning your way around the night sky.
extras: Pick a podcast for the commute

phases.title: Light and quantum basics
phases.summary: What light actually is: measure its speed, then see it behave like a wave with nothing more than a laser pointer.
extras: Watch a short video on wave–particle duality before the double-slit

phases.title: Your first fundamental constant
phases.summary: Use coloured LEDs and a multimeter to measure Planck's constant — the number at the heart of quantum physics.
extras: Order a cheap multimeter and LED kit early

phases.title: Into space
phases.summary: Jupiter is in the evening sky all winter: track its moons on weekend nights and use Kepler's laws to weigh the planet.
extras: Observe on Friday and Saturday nights
Sunspot sketches on clear weekend days

phases.title: Level up
phases.summary: Measure the size of the Earth at the spring equinox, then start simulating physics in code.
